title: XLA Holiday Calendar door data file

_note.description: Free-text note about the file, for example that it holds sample data.

day.description: Day of December. Must match the day in date.

partner.description: Donating partner. Sample data uses fake names.

game.description: Game the bundle is for. Illustrative only in mockups.

items.description: Items in the bundle, for example virtual currency, skins, a key, beta access.

claim_deadline_pt.description: Claim deadline in Pacific Time with explicit offset (-08:00 in December), normally 23:59:59 on date.

state.description: PRD section 8 page states. locked = 'Opens Dec N' (date only, reward hidden). teased = one of the next 3 doors (branded shell plus one-line hint, reward hidden). available = Live. sold_out = cap reached, claim disabled. claimed = 'Claimed, in your Backpack' for this player. missed = Gone (past, not claimable, no catch-up).

special_label.description: Optional door label chip (PRD AD-1, section 8). grand_drop only on days 24, 25, 31 and shown from Dec 1 in the grid.

shell.description: Official XLA frame the item art sits in (PRD glossary). Grand drops use ticket_stub (PRD LD-8). Partners never build shells.

cap.description: Daily claim cap for the door. null means uncapped, which hides the 'N left' counter (PRD LD-2).

remaining.description: Simulated 'N left' for the demo. Never negative. Omit when cap is null.

hint.description: One-line teaser shown on teased doors instead of the reward (PRD LD-6).

gold_bonus.description: Hidden gold bonus item. Slot shows 'Sign in to reveal' when signed out, then is revealed and added to the bundle (PRD LD-7).

news_quest.description: Optional title of the per-door news bonus quest (partner release, update or trailer), rendered as XUI QuestCard (PRD BQ-1).
